input.provenance: Synthetic vminus-tx-v1 fixture: the tx-level dispatcher attacker A' of the V- transaction witness (obligation O10), address 0xaaaa0000000000000000000000000000a2a2a2a2. A dispatcher (CALLDATALOAD(0) >> 224 == 0x12345678) selects between two branches: the start branch builds `remove_liquidity(200, [0, 0], A')` calldata and CALLs the pool proxy with value 0 and all gas; the fallthrough (empty-calldata callback) branch is byte-identical in effect to the old message-level attacker's unconditional body (builds `add_liquidity([100, 0], 0, A')` calldata and CALLs the pool proxy, forwarding CALLVALUE and all gas). Bytes built by scratch scripts/lift/witness/vminus_run.py-adjacent tooling (Plans reports/vminus-tx-v1.md); not a mainnet contract. (A first cut used a hand-typed 19-byte address, one byte short of a valid Adr, which misaligned the two PUSH20 operands after it; fixed before this address was relied on for anything beyond the behavioral EELS probe, which had gone through EELS's own hex_to_address left-pad and so was unaffected.)
